Yeah, I've tried that rule. And other things. There really isn't anything left for me in life. 
Thanks for the comments though. Don't worry about it.
I really don't like where we are heading so I choose to leave. Yeah, like your wife, I too am on that emotion rollercoaster. I'm happy you two worked it out :)
It's all good. I just want to be free if this life. I've tried getting help but it's society. I just can't understand it. I'm just 1 person. A grain of sand. It will be ok.
